What's included

Exactly what gets done, room by room.

This is the whole list, not a summary of it. If something is on it, the crew does it every visit without being asked. If it is not on it, ask us — we will tell you yes or no before the day, not after.

Kitchen

  • Sinks & counters
  • Appliance exteriors
  • Polish fixtures
  • Load dishwasher
  • Range hood inside and out

Bathrooms

  • Shower & tub with detail scrub
  • Toilet
  • Sinks & counters
  • Polish fixtures
  • Clean mirrors

All rooms

  • Dust furniture
  • Cabinets and drawer exteriors
  • Vacuum floors and rugs
  • Mop floors
  • Make beds
  • Remove trash
  • Ceiling fans
  • Light fixtures
  • Vents
  • Woodwork
  • Furniture
  • All decorative items
  • Vacuum upholstery
  • Hand-wipe all baseboards

After the initial deep clean, most customers switch to a standard two-hour clean and stay there. That is the intended path, not an upsell.

Honest limits

What is not on the list.

Published checklists are only worth anything if they are also a boundary. These are the jobs a deep clean does not include as standard. None of them is a refusal — most are things we will happily quote — but you should not discover that on the day.

Ask when you book and we will tell you the time it adds before you commit to it.

Not included as standard

  • Inside the oven and inside the refrigerator
  • Exterior windows
  • Laundry, or dishes beyond loading the dishwasher
  • Anything needing a ladder above standard reach
  • Garages, patios and outdoor living areas

When to book it

Is this the one I need?

Three ways this clean is normally used. If none of them sounds like your house, say so on the phone — we would rather move you to the right one than sell you this one.

01

Every first clean by Blue Fox

We recommend it for everyone starting with us. It buys the crew the extra time to get the areas that have been missed during regular cleanings in the past.

02

Then every three to four months

Even on a good recurring schedule, the high and low edges of a house drift. A deep clean two or three times a year resets them.

03

Before the people arrive

Holidays, house guests, a party, a listing photograph. The difference a deep clean makes is the one a camera can see.

Questions

About the deep clean.

More answers — including the cancellation policy in full — are on the homepage.

Why do you insist on a deep clean first?

Because a two-hour recurring visit has no slack in it. If the vents, the baseboards and the fan blades have been skipped for a year, catching those up inside a basic clean means something else on the list gets skipped instead. One deep clean up front makes every visit after it honest.

How much longer does a deep clean take?

Close to twice a basic clean on the same house — the published checklist roughly doubles in length. The Walkthrough prices it against your actual room count.

How do I get the $100 off?

Mention it when a team member calls you back. It applies to a first deep clean, there is no code, and you do not need to have found it on a particular page.
